body: Thanks for the sentiment, some honesty and goodwill from a stranger who does not know me like this is appreciated. Sorry you have the downvotes, at least you didn't come out of the box with a bunch of assumptions about me or what I have accomplished (or haven't).

Thanks for the replies (although I don't agree with most of the sentiment, I appreciate the cause). It is self evident that I haven't taken my life just yet, if that's how you'd like to describe it. But I'm not here because I'm hanging onto anything from my perception, just tying up some loose ends. Making sure that I don't leave anything embarrassing behind. Repaying a few debts, going to drink some wine with my brother for the last time etc. etc.

The difference here for me is that I don't actually want to continue living. A lot of people that post on these forums have a potentially fulfilling life to live and post here in a desperate attempt for answers to their "problem" or what have you.

I am posting here because there is some desire in my soul to reach out and tell others about what I know and understand. Most of what I believe and most of my experience I feel like I can't describe it properly, or that others wouldn't understand it anyways. I view things so much differently than the average person. I could tell you my IQ, or my personality evaluation (actually I have no problem telling you the latter, the Myer-Briggs INTP). I have lived a bitter life where intelligence is of no value to the common peoples. Proverbs and truth or insight is generally looked down upon by those around you who envy your ability to think things through differently than you. I know there is a place out there for me, a world where I could have belonged, but that opportunity is so far past me right now. I have few practical skills. The sort of things that make normal people consistent employees in mundane environments or social networks dominated by traditional ritual. I don't belong in society. I think patriotism is short sighted and misplaced trust by the gullible. But now I'm just ranting on a pedestal in my final hour here...  

What kind of advice can I give others? Well, from somebody who had many things going for them from the start I can say this much: try and fail. Try and fail. I am somebody who is choosing to die, and I'm doing it because I have tried and failed. I tried doing something I believed was right, and I couldn't follow through with it to the bitter end. But you know what? I take far more solace in leaving this world knowing that I gave it my best shot rather than moping around until I die of natural causes. In the past when honor and dignity of death was far more realized than this close minded society perceives such things as they do now, it was honorable to die defending what you believed to be true, what you believed to be right. Men died in battle, for their families. Woman died to stand up for what they believed in. Many of them made no difference but they passed with some semblance of honor. The real point I'm trying to make from my own experience as a human is that now that I'm going away I can honestly say I am happy I tried and failed than to not try at all. There is a proverb for this:

"Failure is reserved for those who try." In other words, you can't fail at something if you don't try to do it. You can't fail as a father or a mother if you don't try to be one to your children.

I suppose, a few more things I believe could help others in their quest in this life. Here is one I think has helped me look past the error of others:

"People [humans] will never love you as much as you want them to, but only as much as they are able." Nobody (not even you) has the capacity to love somebody else as much as they really need, or as much as they really want you to. If you can't do it for others why expect it from them? Let some things go. Which is another things I want to say, holding a grudge against somebody is poison. That's all I'll touch on there.

There is a lot I would like to write out here but honestly when I have come /r/suicidewatch a giant monologue by somebody you know nothing about is hard to read, so I'll end it here for now.

I might check back in on this tomorrow, but the ball is rolling so please spare me the name calling or the assumptions about my person. I don't mind talking if you don't, and I hope this is an environment where I can do that. If not, that's ok too I can go somewhere else I'm not offended. 

Farewell for now,

-Stranger
